QUOTE: llama.cpp is a git submodule that CMake builds in-tree and statically absorbs into `librentropic.so`. ... `.gitmodules` points `extern/llama.cpp` at `ggml-org/llama.cpp`, pinned to `20a04b22`. ... Not fetched like the others: spdlog, ryml... come in via `FetchContent`... llama.cpp is `add_subdirectory(llama.cpp EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer explicitly says llama.cpp is a git submodule at extern/llama.cpp, contrasting it with FetchContent-fetched dependencies.
